name: China South City Holdings Limited
summary: China South City Holdings Limited, established in 2002 and based in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, develops and operates integrated logistics and trade centers in China, giving wholesalers, manufacturers and retailers a place to trade raw materials and finished goods. It sells and leases commercial units, runs fashion retail outlets and an e-commerce platform, and offers warehousing, property management, exhibitions, advertising, logistics and micro-financing.
